content.title: Karol G at Coachella 2026: Start Time, Setlists and Special Guests
content.text: NewsKarol G at Coachella 2026: start time and everything to knowCoachella’s first Latina headliner takes the stage on Sunday.Karol GCoachella is here, and this year’s edition is packed with global star power. Running across two weekends, April 10 to 12 and April 17 to 19, Coachella’s lineup reflects pop’s international reach and this year features the festival’s first Latina headliner: Karol G. For Karol G, the 2026 booking is a milestone moment. Already one of the most dominant forces in Latin music, her elevation to headliner status underscores both her crossover success and the growing influence of reggaetón and Latin pop on Coachella’s biggest stage. Fans can expect a high-energy, visually rich set that blends stadium-scale production with the personal flair that has defined her rise. What day is Karol G performing at Coachella? Karol G is set to headline on Sunday for both weekends of the festival, meaning she’ll take the main stage on April 12 and April 19. What time will Karol G play the Main Stage? Karol G is scheduled to perform at 9:55pm, after Major Lazer and Young Thug Has Karol G played Coachella before? Yes. Karol G previously performed at Coachella in 2022, where she delivered a high-profile set that included surprise guests and helped solidify her presence with U.S. festival audiences. That performance marked a key step in her crossover trajectory. Has Karol G’s setlist for Coachella been announced yet? No official setlist has been released. Like most headliners, she’s expected to keep details tightly under wraps until the performance. Still, fans can reasonably expect a set built around her biggest hits and recent era, including songs like “TQG,” “Provenza” and “Bichota.” Her live shows often balance crowd anthems with more emotional moments, so a mix of high-energy reggaetón and melodic tracks is likely. Will any guests be joining Karol G’s Coachella set? No guest appearances have been confirmed yet. However, Karol G is known for bringing collaborators onstage, like Becky G, J Balvin and Tiësto at her 2022 Coachella performance. Fingers crossed she brings J Balvin back on stage or possibly Kali Uchis, another fellow Colombian singer and collaborator. Can I live stream Karol G’s Coachella set? Yes. Coachella will live stream performances on YouTube's live Coachella channels both weekends, including major main stage sets. For weekend one, you can watch Karol G on Sunday from 9:55 to 11:55pm on the main stage feed below. What’s the rest of the Coachella 2026 schedule like? You can check out the full festival schedule and lineup—which also includes Sabrina Carpenter, Anyma (whose performance was canceled due to high winds) and Justin Bieber, plus additional sets from the XX, the Strokes, Addison Rae, Young Thug, KATSEYE, BIGBANG and Jack White—below.
